---
name: "Documentation or example / 文档与示例"
about: "Report a confusing instruction, missing example or broken link."
title: "[Docs] "
labels: documentation
---

## Location / 位置

Public file link, heading, package ID and installed version if relevant:

## Gap / 问题

What is unclear or missing? What did you try? Do not include account data or keys.

## Proposed improvement / 建议

Describe a bounded change. Mark any proposed numbers or output as synthetic unless they have permission-cleared sources and observation dates.

## Verification / 验证

How can someone check the improvement offline or in an isolated project? Do not run paid research only to open this issue.
